title: The alley cat rebuilt through the creature kit
_doc: Row 1 is the game's cat (hand-built: unit_models.gd's cat section). Row 2 is the same cat from data/creature_kit.json 'kitcat': the kit's skeleton, legs, poses and sockets under the cat's modelled body and head. Row 3 is 'kitcat_built': the kit's own primitive body and head too. Same rider (the rats' age-2 crossbow rider), same coat.
